selection.policy: Select one primary skill per phase and the smallest supporting set. Classification and foundation are gates, not selectable skills. Ask for confirmation only when ambiguity changes scope, authority, architecture, or proof.

gatePolicy.provenance: The universal pack may copy only allowlisted public upstream material with an integrity-locked manifest. Restricted work-harness inputs contribute behavioral requirements only.
gatePolicy.neutrality: Canonical assets and generated packs must remain project-neutral. Company, product, people, provider, branch, account, customer, incident, and private topology facts belong only in commissioned project adapters.
gatePolicy.privacy: Before handoff, scan canonical and generated artifacts for private paths, identifiers, credentials, customer data, live incident material, and restricted-source residue.
gatePolicy.restricted-residue: When a restricted-source convergence or migration manifest is commissioned, scan the repository, release archives, generated packs, knowledge vault, and installed-skill manifest using only the external runtime manifest. Never commit or print its values.
gatePolicy.skill-retirement: Retire old local skills only from an external manifest, dry-run first, and limit apply mode to exact non-symlink direct children of configured Codex or Claude skill roots.
gatePolicy.schema-compat: Imported assurance concepts must map explicitly into Valdris-native schemas. Layer 0 plus the 13 production-assurance domains remain authoritative; new technologies use capability or domain packs unless the canonical taxonomy itself is deliberately versioned.
gatePolicy.classification: Intake creates run/workload-classification.json from the commissioned taxonomy and binds it to the authorized request and route. Delivery must not rely on an absent, stale, rewritten, or unbound classification.
gatePolicy.foundation: Layer 0 precedes implementation for every non-docs route. All delivery primaries must validate foundation/assessment.json against the required capabilities, effective assurance tier, selected profiles, and proof contract before implementation; audit-only work may report a failing foundation instead of pretending it passed.
gatePolicy.code-intelligence: Required for code, architecture, debugging, refactor, or cross-file claims; docs-only work records a reason.
gatePolicy.production: Required for production-impacting work. The 13 canonical assurance domains are the current shared baseline, not an exhaustive list of literal runtime layers; all begin required, potentially-affected, or not-applicable and must resolve before finish. Asynchronous orchestration is assessed across affected domains as a cross-cutting concern.
gatePolicy.ai-assurance: Required when an AI workload is detected; otherwise write an explicit skipped artifact.
gatePolicy.eval: Required for AI/probabilistic behavior and any commissioned regression or quality threshold; otherwise record non-applicability in the route.
gatePolicy.trajectory: Required for multi-checkpoint or agentic execution.
gatePolicy.smoke: Required for deployed, provider, platform-native, or runtime behavior; otherwise record non-applicability.
gatePolicy.run-packet: Every new completion claim must produce valdris.run-packet.v3 binding intake, route, goal, assurance level, packet-commit catalog bytes, accepted pre-closure gate set, proof, valdris.review.v2 provenance, and applicable RCA and semantic/authoritative artifacts. Non-HEAD and v2 packets receive integrity-only structural inspection; full revalidation requires an isolated exact-commit checkout.
gatePolicy.authoritative-assurance: Semantic and authoritative claims derive tiers and applicability from immutable routing; require typed requirement-to-acceptance traceability, separate signed readiness and later implementation-start events, plan-bound eval/trajectory/smoke evidence, conditional calibrated model judges, tier-capable semantic adapters, typed tool/call receipts, durable memory heads, runtime-driver and implementation receipts, reconciled economics, complete declared MCP/A2A transcripts, dependency provenance, exact context enforcement, signed runtime conformance, full AI identity, Git-reconstructed review, and signed applicable promotion or learning receipts. Authoritative claims additionally require operator-pinned, field-complete model-routing, trajectory-bound trace, usage, memory-head, implementation-execution, proof-input-bound immutable-executor, and rollback-resistant bridge-head receipts.
gatePolicy.review: Every completion requires an Ed25519-attested independent review artifact using valdris.review.v2 with exactly scout, implementer, verifier, and independentReviewer. The actorId, sessionId, and executionId values are each pairwise distinct across all four roles; an authorized independent reviewer from the committed project trust store signs the frozen evidence bundle and complete role roster.
gatePolicy.rca: Bug, regression, incident, and self-heal work requires a typed root-cause artifact that binds reproduction, causal evidence, fix, and regression proof.
gatePolicy.domain-packs: Activate commissioned domain catalogs such as mobile-iOS, multiplayer-realtime, commerce, or youth-safety.
